properties.displayName: SCF - Custom Cognitive Services accounts should have local authentication methods disabled
properties.description: This policy validates if local authentication methods are disabled for Cognitive Services accounts and thereby the requirement of using Azure Active Directory identities exclusively for authentication. Learn more at: https://aka.ms/cs/auth.
